purpose: Every entrypoint-exclusive asset must be explicit; new common features must be shared by default, not added to these exceptions.

app.js.reason: Phone layout, orb/gesture input, shell navigation; shared feature rendering forbidden here.

desktop/desktop.js.reason: Desktop window manager and keyboard/input adapter.

styles.css.reason: Phone shell geometry; common Settings controls extracted.

core/desks.css.reason: Phone desk indicators and dock layout.

core/home-surfaces.css.reason: Phone Home geometry; desktop Home retained from PR22.

orb.js.reason: Phone orb renderer; desktop microphone/chords remain the input adapter.

core/carry-in.js.reason: Android origin migration custody handoff; not desktop storage migration.

device.js.reason: Android update, notification, foreground recorder bridge; web updater already shared.

usuals.js.reason: Grab automation uses Android usuals bridge; never copy non-working purchase controls.

core/tour.js.reason: Phone gestures tutorial; desktop keyboard help is a layout/input-specific guide.

core/tour.css.reason: Phone gesture spotlights; desktop keyboard sheet remains shell-local.

core/voice.js.reason: Desktop browser recorder input; cancellation now uses the common recording store.

pwa-install.js.reason: Phone install prompt only; browser installation capability remains absent on desktop.

data.js.reason: Phone local day/week/month review data. Desktop has no review renderer.

summaries.js.reason: Phone review views; must be extracted before claiming global parity.

core/music-voice.js.reason: Phone local music command parsing; desktop sends voice to agent instead.

core/screen-capture.js.reason: Phone voice screenshot toggle uses this browser-capable module; desktop has no matching voice toggle.

live-mode.js.reason: Explicit opt-in experimental simulated Live Mode, not enabled live; no desktop preview yet.
